finding.en: Distended abdomen with left lower tenderness and rebound, without guarding.

finding.zh-CN: 未触及明确包块，左肾区叩痛。
finding.en: No definite mass was palpated; left renal-angle tenderness was present.

text.zh-CN: 左下腹囊实性肿块约 7.1×6.3×9.9 cm，周围脂肪模糊及腹盆腔积液；超声示血流。
text.en: A left lower mixed cystic/solid mass around 7.1×6.3×9.9 cm, blurred surrounding fat and abdominopelvic fluid; Doppler showed vascularity.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 大肠镜无明显异常，小肠造影见外压但无外漏，支持肠外占位。
text.en: Colonoscopy was unremarkable; small-bowel contrast showed extrinsic compression without leakage, supporting an extraintestinal mass.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: WBC 由 28.8 增至 33.3×10⁹/L，以成熟中性粒细胞为主；骨髓粒系活跃、无明显形态异常。两次血培养阴性。
text.en: WBC rose from 28.8 to 33.3×10⁹/L, predominantly mature neutrophils; marrow showed active granulopoiesis without obvious atypia. Two blood cultures were negative.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 肠系膜根部肿块及广泛粟粒结节；冰冻曾疑转移腺癌，最终组织及免疫组合诊断恶性间皮瘤：calretinin、CK18、vimentin 阳性，CEA 阴性。
text.en: A mesenteric-root mass with widespread nodules; frozen section suggested metastatic adenocarcinoma, but final tissue/immunophenotype diagnosed malignant mesothelioma: calretinin/CK18/vimentin positive and CEA negative.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 因病情及手术评估未行完整肿块切除，仅取组织。白细胞后来增至 113.7×10⁹/L，以中性粒细胞为主，抗菌无效；原团队考虑类白血病反应。患者随后离院，长期结局未知。
text.en: Complete tumour resection was not performed after clinical/surgical assessment; tissue was obtained. WBC later reached 113.7×10⁹/L, predominantly neutrophils, despite antimicrobials; the team considered a leukemoid response. The patient left and long-term outcome is unknown.

hint.zh-CN: 指出支持证据、反证和仍需核对的信息。
hint.en: Identify supporting evidence, conflicting evidence and remaining gaps.

hint.en: Separate the reported outcome from evidence available at the decision point.

prompt.zh-CN: 应怎样处理冰冻与最终病理的差异？
prompt.en: How should frozen/final pathology discordance be handled?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 结合完整形态、免疫组合和临床定位，最终支持恶性间皮瘤
text.en: Integrate full morphology, immunophenotype and location; the final diagnosis supports mesothelioma

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把初步冰冻意见当成不可修订结论。
feedback.en: A preliminary frozen interpretation is revisable.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭冰冻固定转移腺癌
text.en: Fix metastatic adenocarcinoma from frozen section alone

feedback.zh-CN: 后续综合病理已经改变判断。
feedback.en: Later integrated pathology changed the interpretation.

text.zh-CN: 单个 calretinin 阳性足以确诊所有间皮瘤
text.en: Calretinin positivity alone diagnoses every mesothelioma

feedback.zh-CN: 标志物需组合并结合形态。
feedback.en: Markers require a panel and morphology.

prompt.zh-CN: 持续发热与白细胞升高应怎样评估？
prompt.en: How should persistent fever and leukocytosis be assessed?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 持续评估感染，同时考虑肿瘤相关类白血病反应并与血液病理协作
text.en: Continue infection assessment while considering tumour-related leukemoid response with haematopathology input

feedback.zh-CN: 成熟粒细胞增生及抗菌无效提示其他机制。
feedback.en: Mature granulopoiesis and poor antimicrobial response prompt alternative mechanisms.

text.zh-CN: 白细胞很高即可确诊急性白血病
text.en: A high WBC alone proves acute leukaemia

feedback.zh-CN: 需要细胞形态和谱系证据。
feedback.en: Morphology and lineage evidence are needed.

text.zh-CN: 两次阴性培养即可彻底排除感染
text.en: Two negative cultures absolutely exclude infection

feedback.zh-CN: 仍需临床评估和来源核对。
feedback.en: Clinical and source assessment remain necessary.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续极高白细胞说明什么？
prompt.en: What does later extreme leukocytosis establish?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 与类白血病反应相容，但没有细胞因子或克隆检测的全部确证
text.en: It fits a leukemoid response, without full cytokine or clonality confirmation

feedback.zh-CN: 应保持原报告推断的边界。
feedback.en: Retain the limits of the report’s inference.

text.zh-CN: 已证实肿瘤分泌 G-CSF
text.en: Tumour G-CSF secretion is proven

text.zh-CN: 未切除就能确定已死亡
text.en: Non-resection proves death

feedback.zh-CN: 离院后的生存没有记录。
feedback.en: Survival after departure was not recorded.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 最终病理诊断腹膜间皮瘤，伴极度成熟粒细胞增多，需区别感染与肿瘤相关反应。
conclusion.en: Final pathology diagnosed peritoneal mesothelioma with extreme mature neutrophilia, requiring distinction between infection and tumour-related reaction.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 定位与病理需相互核对。
不能凭单一免疫标志物或旧文 nm-23 解释判定原发/转移。
keyReasoning.en: Do not use one immunostain or the source’s old nm-23 interpretation to establish primary versus metastatic origin.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 类白血病反应是综合判断，不等同于已测得细胞因子。
keyReasoning.en: A leukemoid response is an integrated interpretation, not proof of measured cytokines.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.zh-CN: 石棉暴露、完整现代病理面板、克隆/细胞因子评估及离院后结局未载。
unknowns.en: Asbestos exposure, a complete modern pathology panel, clonality/cytokine studies and post-departure outcome are absent.
